_comment_key: Public key pinning the extension ID to fammlfkggfbbfjbklabaceiojabannnc. Without it Chrome derives the ID from each machine's install path, so every unpacked install gets a different chrome.identity.getRedirectURL() and FACEIT rejects the authorize request. Safe to commit — it is the public half. Remove before uploading to the Chrome Web Store, which assigns its own ID.
